page_contract.buyer_role: Innovation lead / trust architect / technical decision owner
page_contract.canonical_job: Decide what another party must be able to verify, then choose the minimum defensible mechanism.
page_contract.positioning_invariant: PROPERTY → VERIFIER → DISCLOSURE BOUNDARY → AUTHORITY → MINIMUM MECHANISM → INDEPENDENT ACCEPTANCE
page_contract.anti_maximalist_invariant: A documented no-blockchain outcome remains a valid paid outcome when a controlled database, signature or conventional audit trail satisfies the acceptance condition.

customer_avatar_contract.frustrations_fears: night_worries; annoyances; daily_challenges; blockers; failing_systems; difficult_required_interactions; recurrent_product_or_service_complaints
customer_avatar_contract.wants_aspirations: self_outcomes; team_outcomes; desired_role_state; goals; values; evidence_bounded_private_aspirations
customer_avatar_contract.key_purchase_drivers: must_have_features; service_expectations; quality_expectations; price_and_purchase_considerations; deal_killers; objections; stakeholders; decision_maker; advocate; champion
customer_avatar_contract.epistemic_rule: Unknown demographic or psychographic detail MUST remain MISSING_EVIDENCE. A synthesized phrase MUST NOT be presented as a customer verbatim.

identity.field: Technical decision owner / internal advocate across a cross-functional decision unit. Budget authority is not established.
The answer cannot remain 'trust us' when the other party is accountable for the decision.

frustrations_fears.pressure: Cross-organizational assurance breaks when verification depends on privileged access or operator assertion. Business consequences modelled: longer assurance cycles, excessive disclosure and blocked collaboration.
Trust commitments fail when policy is not encoded into enforceable, observable architecture. Consequences modelled: policy drift, inconsistent implementation, audit friction and residual risk.
A proof mechanism that cannot fit production latency, tooling and operating procedures is likely to be bypassed or remain in pilot.
frustrations_fears.boundary: No claim is made about insomnia, personal fear intensity, emotional state or frequency in a real population. Those require interviews/CRM evidence.

wants_aspirations.objective: Prove selected properties without disclosing more sensitive data than necessary. Candidate metrics: verification completion time, manual evidence requests, disclosure surface, verification failure rate and reusable proof coverage.
Translate trust and policy commitments into enforceable technical controls. Candidate metrics: policy-control coverage, exception count, policy drift and owner coverage.

Make data flows, ownership and provenance explicit enough to audit and challenge. Candidate metrics: lineage coverage, ownership coverage, audit-evidence retrieval time, unmapped sensitive flows and exception ageing.

Enable selected sensitive workloads only once integrity properties can be established. Candidate metrics: attestation pass rate, protected-workload coverage, failed integrity checks, key-release blocks and verification latency.
wants_aspirations.values: bounded disclosure; independent verification; enforceability; provenance; operability; reversible mechanism choice
wants_aspirations.secret_desires: Do not invent status or private psychological aspirations.

key_purchase_drivers.must_have: Exact property to verify and named verifier.
Least-complex sufficient mechanism; database/no-chain remains admissible.
Authority and key lifecycle: authorization, delegation, revocation, recovery and escalation.
Independent acceptance procedure and reusable evidence/provenance.
Operational fit: latency, tooling, incident and handoff constraints.
key_purchase_drivers.service_expectation: Architecture decision and implementation evidence must remain inspectable and transferable to another technical team.
key_purchase_drivers.quality_expectation: Claims are bounded to tested properties; no universal faster/cheaper/security claim.
key_purchase_drivers.price_purchase_considerations: No numeric willingness-to-pay or budget authority is established for Élodie.
key_purchase_drivers.deal_killer: Internal-only shared register where an accountable database already satisfies the verifier and evidence requirement.
No sponsor, no authorized evidence access or no concrete verifier.
Purchase intent is primarily trend/buzzword/token-price driven rather than a bounded verification need.
Request requires legal/regulatory sign-off outside the contracted role.
key_purchase_drivers.objections: Do not convert qualification rules into alleged customer objections without CRM or interview evidence.

decision_unit.stakeholder: Assurance framework, audit evidence and residual-risk decision
Hardware/software trust chain and protected execution
Storage, transformation, access and provenance metadata
External acceptance, procurement/security challenge and trust decision

dimension.name: HAVE
dimension.before: Trust-by-assertion, evidence reconstructed through access-heavy/manual paths, policy commitments that may not be technically enforceable.
dimension.after: A bounded property is independently checkable; disclosure is limited; authority is explicit; evidence/provenance can be reused.

before_after.dimension: Validate by interview; do not invent anxiety, confidence or relief.
Candidate operational change: fewer manual evidence requests and shorter evidence-retrieval/verification loops. This is not an observed performance result until measured.
Validate organizational/status change before marketing it.

dimension.name: SYSTEMIC_FAILURE_MODE_TO_GOVERNANCE_PRINCIPLE
dimension.before: Trust-by-assertion, unnecessary disclosure and non-operational proof.
dimension.after: Independent verification, bounded disclosure and a mechanism that can be operated, challenged, revoked and handed off.
